name: Dusk
source:
In 1992 a wave of unusual and gruesome crimes swept across the East coast of America, leaving eight dead and ten missing. Among those missing were two detectives, Josef Von Abend and his assistant, Shirley Ibsen. The culprit was never found, and after several years, the case was abandoned.

Ten years later, in 2002, amateur detective Marian Castallo receives a declaration of war, just as a similar wave of crimes begins, suggesting that Josef Von Abend may still be alive.

This project has been canceled and is no longer in production. Only a demo has been released.
translation:
1992年，一系列异常而骇人的犯罪席卷美国东海岸，造成八人死亡、十人失踪。失踪者中包括两名侦探：约瑟夫·冯·阿本德和他的助手雪莉·易卜生。凶手始终没有落网，几年后，案件被搁置。

十年后的2002年，就在相似的犯罪浪潮再度出现之际，业余侦探玛丽安·卡斯塔洛收到了一封战书，种种迹象表明约瑟夫·冯·阿本德可能依然活着。

本项目已被取消，不再继续制作，目前只发布过试玩版。
